steps.title: Configure Application Metadata
steps.description: Establish the application name 'Space Run 3D' and define the package package identifier 'com.spacerun3d.app'.

steps.title: Define Build Configuration
steps.description: Set up app/build.gradle with Android SDK 34, compile versions, namespace variables, and ensure compatible native Java 17 configuration.

steps.title: Configure Android Manifest
steps.description: Implement AndroidManifest.xml declaring GLES 2.0 requirements, full-screen orientation, and proper application icon setups.

steps.title: Design Cyberpunk Neon Button XML Style
steps.description: Create button style drawables using standard XML shape definitions for neon-cyan game controllers.

steps.title: Design Cyberpunk Danger Button XML Style
steps.description: Create button style drawables using standard XML shape definitions for neon-red warning actions and restarts.

steps.title: Build Main XML Layout HUD
steps.description: Implement a full layout displaying the GLSurfaceView with a transparent absolute layout overlay displaying health shields, scores, left/right direction keys, and an overlay game over state.

steps.title: Construct Native OpenGL Shaders
steps.description: Code custom Vertex and Fragment Shaders supporting perspective transformations and realistic 3D vertex position-based gradient shading.

steps.title: Build standard 3D Cube geometry class
steps.description: Construct standard 3D cube model specifying vertices, drawing indices list, and dynamic custom uniform-tint rendering.

steps.title: Build 3D Floor perspective grid class
steps.description: Construct large 3D perspective floor/road extending deep into the virtual scene to simulate high-speed running rails.

steps.title: Develop 3D Obstacle Spawning and Updates
steps.description: Program random coordinate obstacle generator logic, advancing obstacle Z coordinates towards player views on each frame update.

steps.title: Implement Real-time 3D Collision Detection
steps.description: Formulate 3D AABB bounding-box check checking relative spatial overlapping distances on X and Z axes between player coordinates and obstacles.

steps.title: Implement Infinite Road Lane Speed Markers
steps.description: Implement multiple secondary moving 3D structures running backwards over the floor to enforce visual illusions of super speed velocity.

steps.title: Connect Touch Handlers to Game Mechanics
steps.description: Build high-refresh continuous touch-listener states driving player cube horizontal velocities smoothly on left/right inputs.

steps.title: Implement Game State Transition Machine
steps.description: Set up start, playing, and reset status configurations connected via standard UI triggers, cleanly driving screen overlays.

steps.title: Building Space Run 3D
steps.description: Execute final build verification using Gradle assembling process to ensure correct rendering performance.
